title: Eidolon/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Onkko: And now, a massive Sentient energy spike in your area. I advise you to be careful."
- Onkko: Those devices draw energy from Vomvalysts. Make use of them."
- Onkko: Next, you attempt to take control of it."
- Onkko: Your weapons have no effect on its shields. Try something else."

path: Once a single destroyed Synovia has a charged Lure attached
lines: - Onkko: That device is insufficient. You are directed to secure and employ additional Eidolon lures."

path: Once all destroyed Synovias have a charged Lure attached
lines: - Onkko: Sentient energy contained. You are closing on victory. Act now!"

path: Destroying a Synovia without a charged Lure
lines: - Onkko: The Teralyst retreats, but remains close by, wary of you."
